status: Billing now has a bounded native Holding billing workspace read, native Platform actual-cost review commands, an owner-local HTTP router and a configured Next SSR read cutover. The owner remains pending/partial: the full five-workflow catalogue, Stripe subscription/checkout mutations, background jobs, shared composition mounting, root workspace membership and browser acceptance remain open.

scope.workflowBoundary: The qualified read returns one current Holding's billing account, latest enrollment, plan revisions, service periods, metered costs, invoices, audit, pending jobs and retained legacy beta-billing status. The qualified commands record or remove one unissued metered cost and set the explicit period cost-review flag. Entitlement enforcement, plan publication/subscription changes, Stripe customer/checkout/portal changes, invoice issue/void, payment mode, provider verification, target rating/rollout, background jobs, evidence intake and every other billing workflow command remain on the retained TypeScript owner. No whole workflow is claimed verified.
scope.domain: Platform read roles platform_admin/platform_auditor; Platform write role platform_admin only; exact Holding-owner read for the target Holding; optional work-context expiry; no Company dimension widening. Exact 500-row workspace bounds, 100-row audit bound, unique ids, descending period month/invoice/audit order, plan revision order, month/status/category/money/date validation, period and invoice reference integrity, and fail-closed source validation. Command facts cover 3..1000-character reasons, 1..2000-character notes, category/negative-cost policy, adjustment original-invoice requirement, actual-evidence requirement, simulated label, service-date period containment, exact expected account version and deterministic owner receipt identity.
scope.application: billing_workspace checks the actor before any repository call, loads only the target Holding rows, validates the complete bounded projection and returns the exact retained Billing view shape. execute_cost_command checks the Platform administrator, validates the command, locks the Holding and command key, replays an exact canonical receipt or rejects a different digest, checks Holding/account existence and exact account-version CAS, applies one record/delete/complete effect, increments the account version with CAS, writes audit and the command receipt in the same caller transaction and validates persisted cost/period/receipt readback.
scope.adapters: PostgreSQL SQL is Billing-owned Control SQL: billing_accounts, billing_enrollments, billing_plans, billing_periods, billing_costs, billing_invoices, billing_audit, billing_jobs, billing_evidence, billing_receipts and the retained Billing legacy beta_billing/stripe_inbox sources, plus the existing holding_bindings existence check. No cross-owner Holding SQL, Stripe request, invoice issue, job dispatch or commit is performed. The read and command adapters require the caller's serializable Control transaction.
scope.http: Owner-local axum router: GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/billing; POST /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/billing/costs/{record|delete|complete}. It enforces exact registered Host/Holding target, exact origin when present, no query, application/json, bounded body, Idempotency-Key, exact camelCase JSON keys, owner domain validation and BusinessError-to-HTTP mapping. Private/no-store, no-referrer and nosniff headers are retained.
scope.ssr: packages/server-billing/src/adapters/billing-presentation.ts now reads the selected Billing view through the native owner transport for the server-render initial data when ERPX_NATIVE_BILLING_CONFIG is present, forwarding the current Host/cookie/context headers. A configured but unavailable or malformed native read fails closed. Without the configuration the retained TypeScript view remains the declared fallback. Platform account selection and the retained BillingConsole 15-second poll still use the TypeScript API route; only the selected Holding initial server-render view is native.
scope.outboxNote: The retained Billing command boundary has no Billing outbox table and writes one billing_audit row plus one billing_receipts row in the same transaction; the native command preserves exactly those owner effects. No new outbox or cross-owner effect was invented.

The SSR read cutover requires ERPX_NATIVE_BILLING_CONFIG; no browser or normal-session acceptance was attempted, so the actual page appearance and navigation are unverified.
Native command transport is not wired to the BillingConsole POST client; the retained TypeScript API route still owns browser commands.
Platform account selection, Stripe/provider behavior, jobs, entitlement enforcement and the other Billing workflows remain retained.
No claim is made that the Billing owner is complete; docs/status/rust-backend-migration.json was not updated (forbidden) and owner surfaces remain recorded as pending.
